name: 29053 · Gaston, SC
findings: ZIP 29053 (Gaston) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29053 (Gaston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
